name: rear-hand cross punch
rules: The feet stay planted on exactly the same pixels in every frame (only the back heel lifts 1 pixel on the hit).
The head stays upright and level; it moves forward at most 2 pixels.
The punching arm is the REAR arm (the far arm, on the left side of the body in cell 1). Power chain: hips move first, then torso, then arm, then fist, each one frame later.
The pink scarf lags the head by one frame: lifts during the wind-up, pulled straight back during the strike, drops on the recover, swings forward on the overshoot.

frames.pose: wind-up A: hips 1 pixel lower, rear shoulder pulled 1 pixel back, rear fist cocked next to the chin
wind-up B: torso rotating forward, rear elbow lifting, head 1 pixel forward, upright
strike in progress: rear arm three-quarters extended forward at visor height, the front hand rising to guard the chin
rear arm reaching full extension forward at visor height

HIT: rear arm perfectly straight and horizontal at visor height, a little longer than natural, fist at its farthest point; head 2 pixels forward and level, back heel lifted 1 pixel, front knee slightly more bent; scarf pulled straight back
follow: same as the hit pose with the arm 1 pixel shorter
recover: rear fist pulled back low to the chest; scarf dropping
overshoot: the original guard stance shifted 1 pixel BACK; scarf swinging forward
